clue.text: Others are at ease

definitions.meaning: the others are the remainder, everyone left over
to be at ease is to relax, take a break from effort

explanation.surface: Everybody else is relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: The remaining people are 'the rest', and people relaxing take a rest: two senses of one word.

clue.text: Slight incline

definitions.meaning: slight here means thin, slender in build
to incline is to tilt or slope to one side

explanation.definitionFit: A slight, thin figure is lean, and to tilt is to lean: an adjective and a verb sharing a spelling.

clue.text: Up-country there's a large expanse of water

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for the country is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name for Ireland

explanation.surface: Inland, somebody notes a big lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' turns EIRE, the Irish name for Ireland, into one of North America's Great Lakes. 'there's' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Erie, one of the Great Lakes, is a vast body of fresh water.

clue.text: A music man can get nastier

indicators.note: the letters of the next word can get turned into something new, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A musician may turn nastier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can get' signals that NASTIER is rearranged. Sir John Stainer was a Victorian English composer and organist.
explanation.definitionFit: John Stainer was an English composer of church music, so he is a man of music.

clue.text: The fool! To importune the German command!

parts.note: to dun is to press a debtor persistently for payment
der is a German word for 'the'
to head something is to lead or command it

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry at an idiot who pesters a German officer for orders.
explanation.definitionFit: A dunderhead is a stupid person, a dolt or blockhead.

clue.text: A writer, and badly treated it's understood

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument, a writer

indicators.note: treated badly means the letters of the word are mishandled into a new order

explanation.surface: An author has been poorly handled, it is accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' shuffles TREATED into ETRATED, placed after PEN. 'and' and 'it's' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To penetrate an idea is to see into it and grasp it, so penetrated means comprehended.

clue.text: The underworld boss coppers let out appears put out

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld
p stands for pence, copper coins
to lease property is to let it out for rent

explanation.surface: The gangland chief whom police released looks annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police but means pennies, P. 'appears' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To put someone out is to annoy or offend them, to make them unhappy.

clue.text: Heads back to deliver a knockout blow

indicators.note: back says the word for heads is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: nuts is slang for heads

explanation.surface: Boxers' heads jerk backwards from a knockout punch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NUTS, slang for heads, around.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun someone is to knock them senseless, as a knockout punch does.

clue.text: Drinks supplied for nurses-tea possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters given could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Hospital staff are served tea, or perhaps something stronger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges the letters of NURSES and TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Sauternes is a sweet white dessert wine from Bordeaux; the name ends in S, so it can stand for glasses of it.

clue.text: Places of work. Orders are sent in

indicators.note: to order things is to arrange them, so the following letters are put into a new sequence

explanation.surface: Workplaces where instructions are dispatched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Orders' looks like a noun meaning instructions but is a verb: it rearranges the letters of ARE SENT IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tannery is a workshop where hides are turned into leather.

clue.text: Born in June, early June

indicators.note: in shows the letters sit inside the words that follow, across the join

explanation.surface: Born in early summer.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of June and the start of early. The final June repeats the month and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Née, from French, introduces a woman's maiden name: born with that surname.

clue.text: A little round object given free

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small ball handed out at no charge.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo a knot or fastening is to release it, setting something loose.

clue.text: Parking-it can cause depression

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Parking can make you miserable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depression' reads as low mood but means a hollow in the ground. 'can cause' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A pit is a hole or hollow sunk into the ground, a physical depression.

clue.text: Rate a spring flower

parts.note: speed is a rate of motion
a well is a spring or source of water

explanation.surface: Grading a blossom that comes up in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' suggests the season but is a water source, a well.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedwell is a small blue-flowered plant, Veronica.

clue.text: Competent directors will be anything but baffling

parts.note: sound means reliable, competent
a company's board is its directors

explanation.surface: Capable executives will make everything clear.
explanation.walkthrough: A baffle is a panel that deadens sound; a soundboard does the opposite and amplifies it. 'will be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A soundboard reflects and strengthens sound in an instrument, the reverse of a baffle, which muffles it.

clue.text: Admitting there's confusing order before racing

indicators.note: before puts this piece ahead of the word that follows
confusing jumbles the letters of the order's abbreviation

parts.note: the MBE is an order of chivalry, Member of the Order of the British Empire
taken as written

explanation.surface: Letting someone in where the orders are muddled before a race meeting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusing' turns MBE into EMB, which goes ahead of RACING.
explanation.definitionFit: Embracing an idea means accepting or taking it in, so it means admitting.

clue.text: Harangues a bride it's awful

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters before it are in a terrible state, mixed up

explanation.surface: Ranting tirades: a bride complains it's dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' rearranges A BRIDE IT'S, whose S counts as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a bitter verbal attack, a tirade or harangue.

clue.text: Get sound equipment. There's point to that

parts.note: the ear is the body's equipment for sound
N for north is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Buying audio gear has some purpose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound equipment' suggests speakers, but means the organ of hearing. 'There's' and 'to that' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn money is to gain or obtain it through work.

clue.text: Buns are maybe provided for a honey-eater

indicators.note: maybe hints the letters could be put another way

explanation.surface: Buns may be set out for a creature with a sweet tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges BUNS ARE. 'provided for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun bear of South-East Asia is famed for raiding bees' nests for honey.

clue.text: Many a junior is idle

parts.note: M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many
under means younger than, junior

explanation.surface: Lots of young employees slack off.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords 'many' can be M, the Roman thousand.
explanation.definitionFit: To maunder is to wander about or talk aimlessly, idling.

clue.text: Give a talking-to, being direct

definitions.meaning: to give a talk to an audience is to speak to them formally
to direct a letter is to write its destination on it

explanation.surface: Deliver a speech, being straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: One makes a formal speech to people, and one writes a destination on an envelope: both senses of one verb.

clue.text: English and retiring

annotationWithheld.why: clue held as 'English and retiring (4)': E + reversed AND builds EDNA but no word defines the girl's name, so the definition is missing

clue.text: Put on fresh clothing and made up

definitions.meaning: having changed into other clothes, dressed once more
made up for a wrong, set it right

explanation.surface: Changed outfits and applied cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: Re-dressed is dressed again, while redressed means a wrong was put right, compensated.

clue.text: Accordingly a quarter gave an out-moded call for help

parts.note: so means therefore, accordingly
S for south is one quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: So one district sent a distress signal of old.
explanation.walkthrough: The Morse distress signal was formally replaced at sea in 1999. 'gave' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Morse distress signal has been superseded by satellite systems, so it is now dated.

clue.text: A letter one's written after church

indicators.note: written after places the numeral one following the church abbreviation

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone pens a letter after a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: The Roman numeral I follows CH.
explanation.definitionFit: Chi is the twenty-second character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Seeing nothing in big rough area not producing crops

indicators.note: in puts the zero inside the rearranged letters
rough means the word before it is roughed up, its letters disordered

parts.note: O, the shape of zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Finding no yield in a huge, rugged tract of farmland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rough' turns BIG into GBI, and 'in' puts O inside it. 'Seeing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gobi is the great desert of Mongolia and China, barren land.

clue.text: A lawyer, having the right, is engaged in trade

indicators.note: engaged in means held inside, so the right and is go within the word for trade

parts.note: to barter is to trade goods
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: An attorney with legal entitlement takes up commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: R and IS go inside BARTER. 'having' is a link. A barrister is a British courtroom lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrister is a lawyer who pleads in the higher courts.

clue.text: A Russian's one form of transport

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a van is a road vehicle

explanation.surface: A Russian man owns a lorry.
explanation.walkthrough: 's is a link here, standing for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivan is the typical Russian man's name, the Russian form of John.

clue.text: Not drinking-sheltering in the shade

indicators.note: sheltering means one piece wraps around and protects another

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, abstaining from alcohol

explanation.surface: A teetotaller sits out of the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheltering' puts IN inside TT.
explanation.definitionFit: A tint is a shade or hue of a colour.

clue.text: Finish after mid-afternoon break

indicators.note: after puts the ending piece behind the central letter
mid picks out the central letter of the word joined to it

parts.note: end means finish

explanation.surface: Stop work after the midday tea break.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letter of AFTERNOON is R, which comes before END.
explanation.definitionFit: To rend is to tear apart, to break violently.

clue.text: A self-satisfied person's quiet outfit

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet
a rig is an outfit of clothes

explanation.surface: A smug type's understated garb.
explanation.walkthrough: 's is a link standing for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A prig is someone smugly self-righteous about their own virtue.

clue.text: Broke down -isn't using a bear, ing

indicators.note: broke down means the words were taken apart and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A machine fails because it lacks a bearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broke down' rearranges ISN'T USING A.
explanation.definitionFit: Sustaining weight is bearing it, holding it up.
